race.comment: WHO BUT ROO (10) tough Canberra sprinter who ran a creditable fifth in a much stronger race over 1100m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Likely to measure up at the big odds. MONTE KATE (1) rewarded for her consistency when she dropped in class for a determined on-speed win over 1300m at Warwick Farm. Jumps slightly in weight after the claim and shapes as one of the main contenders. SUPER NORWEST (7) lacked match practice first up with a tiring twelfth over 1100m at Randwick.  Has a sound second-up record and is worth thought with the 3kg claim. LIGHTNING GLORY (5) resumes. Won three-in-a-row before heading to town with a tiring tenth over 1300m at Rosehill in a BM78 last June. Trialled well and undefeated in two first up starts.
